option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and genetic testing results match the characteristics of Epidermolytic ichthyosis (bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma), which is equivalent to Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma.
The clinical presentation and genetic testing results do not match the characteristics of Superficial epidermolytic ichthyosis.
The clinical presentation and genetic testing results do not match the characteristics of Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens.
The clinical presentation and genetic testing results do not match the characteristics of Annular epidermolytic ichthyosis (AEI).
